items.title: Ford CEO on Le Mans, New Electric Pickup and Trade Talks
items.summary: Bloomberg's Matt Miller sits down with Ford CEO Jim Farley to talk racing, Ford's planned $30,000 electric pickup, Chinese EV competition and USMCA trade talks, zeroing in on how to protect US auto manufacturing while competing on a global stage.

items.title: Rivian Is Down 41% This Year. Can RIVN Stock Get Back to $20 in 2027?
items.summary: Rivian posted record deliveries and a hit new R2, yet investors keep heading for the exits while losses pile up. Three pressure points will decide whether the factory-floor momentum ever reaches the share price.

items.title: General Motors Is Up 11% in a Month as the Nasdaq-100 Fell 10%. Is Its Nasdaq Switch Really That Good?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Motors stock is up 11% in the past month, mostly on its move to Nasdaq, while the Nasdaq-100 fell 10%. Ford’s higher profit floor and a shift out of Tesla helped too, but Ford expects flat 2027 profit.

items.title: Ford (F) Agreed To A $390.5 Million Transmission Defect Settlement
items.summary: Ford Motor (NYSE:F) agreed to a proposed US$390.5 million settlement resolving transmission defect claims affecting up to 180,000 drivers. The class action deal addresses long running allegations over certain automatic transmissions and follows years of vehicle quality complaints. Ford has been in talks with the Pentagon about supplying components for military drone production as a potential new revenue stream. items.summary: Ford Motor has seen its assessed fair value edge down from US$15.28 to about US$14.96 per share, which contributes to a slightly lower price target narrative.
